steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest: fill the gaps (3 min)
steps.instructions: Fill the gaps with the words in the box. Change the form if needed. Box: give up · confident · make progress · pick up · job satisfaction · work-life balance

items.label: 1. Many people choose a job with good ______, not only a high salary.
2. Helping customers gives me a lot of ______.
3. I ______ some Japanese words from anime.
5. After three months, my listening ______ a lot.
6. She feels ______ when she speaks English now.

steps.title: Step 2 · Dictation (5 min)
steps.instructions: Listen to 5 sentences. Each sentence is read twice. Write the missing information. Numbers as digits.
